searchText: Yea... I think at this point the time to actually fix it isn't worth it. Always open to if someone sees something I haven't though! From what I can tell Kodiak fails every time 🙅‍♀️ I've told them about this, btw. I think I'll just remove it soon and think of some other hacky approach 😭 I'm guessing I'm missing some elegant solution tbh..
